arguments.text: Verified final Stage 2 implementation: work.py looks up policy.edges[from>to], blocks missing edges, enforces an edge role before retry validation, and validates attempts only for edges marked retry. Retry attempts must be an int but not bool and satisfy 0 <= attempts < retry_limit; retry edges also fail when attempts is absent. Success/failure shapes and reasons match the task, inputs remain unchanged, and non-retry edges preserve prior behavior even if an attempts field is present. report.json equals evaluation of all requests.json entries with policy.json. Actual local checks passed; evidence.json is absent. No unresolved questions.
